research_contract: Under applicable SMP and PMU configuration/hardware, cross-CPU PMU initialization consuming the online-CPU set should follow SMP online readiness; unrelated hotplug, preemptibility, failure cleanup and run-time event setup are not interchangeable.

query.paths_note: Git path-limited --name-only returned matching queried paths only, not each commit's complete changed-file set. Merge entries can have no names in this mode.
query.parser_note: Removed NUL bytes from WSL warning; parsed only SHA40/TAB/date/TAB/subject headers, so the first commit was retained.

pollution_check.scope: existing experiments/case_taxonomy *.md, *.json and *.tsv references to all 100 twelve-character SHA prefixes
pollution_check.limitation: Absence of a SHA reference is not proof that the code has never been read elsewhere. File and mechanism overlap must also be audited before any future freeze.

decision.reason: 唯一标题明确指向 SMP online 后 PMU 初始化的修订 f3334ebb8a2a 已参与开发；其余近邻标题并未提供同一启动阶段消费机制。已知同接口正常对照 4c8a7c982772 已读；无新阳性时不增加正常回放充当泛化验证。
decision.next_action: 若下一轮扩大元数据池，先独立冻结新的跨架构 PMU/SMP 初始阶段候选范围，并记录完整池和阅读污染；确认可合理预期同机制新阳性后再冻结提取器和正常对照。

coverage_limitations: 本轮六个路径历史由 x86 高频修改占多数；未覆盖 drivers/perf 中 ARM PMUv3 搬迁后的全部历史，也未覆盖 PowerPC 等架构。
最多 100 条包含合并提交，不代表所有历史 PMU 修订已检查。
未找到候选是有界元数据筛选结果，不是 Linux 中不存在同类问题，也不构成规则假阴性、阴性正常或召回率。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86: Guard intel_pmu_cpu_dead() against invalid hybrid PMU casts
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为 CPU dead/hybrid PMU 类型检查，不能据此推断启动前 SMP online 消费顺序。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86: Free hybrid state on PMU init failure
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为 PMU 初始化失败时的状态释放，不是在线 CPU 集合准备完成前的跨 CPU 消费。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86: Unregister PMI handler on PMU init failure
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为 PMU 初始化失败时卸载处理程序，不是 SMP online 的阶段修订。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86: Move event pointer setup earlier in x86_pmu_enable()
shortlist_review.reason: 标题在 x86_pmu_enable() 中提前事件指针设置，可能是运行期首次使用顺序，但不能替代启动阶段在线 CPU 契约。

shortlist_review.subject: LoongArch: Fix PMU counter allocation for mixed-type event groups
shortlist_review.reason: 修复混合事件组计数器分配，同 PMU 文件路径可作以后正常对照候选；未证明相同初始化接口，也未解封。

shortlist_review.subject: LoongArch: Refine the init_hw_perf_events() function
shortlist_review.reason: 标题指向已知同接口正常对照，但 9/28 已运行且解封，不能计新增独立对照。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86/intel: Initialize architectural PEBS
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为新增/初始化 PEBS 支持，未指明 SMP online 之前的消费或阶段修复。

shortlist_review.subject: perf/x86: Fix smp_processor_id()-in-preemptible warnings
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为可抢占上下文中的 smp_processor_id() 警告，未指明 online CPU 集合的启动阶段要求。

shortlist_review.subject: LoongArch/smp: Refine some ipi functions on LoongArch platform
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为 IPI 函数整理，与 CPU 相关但没有初始化阶段修订证据。

shortlist_review.subject: LoongArch: Lately init pmu after smp is online
shortlist_review.reason: 标题直接符合所需机制，但 9/28 已读源码、补丁并参与开发，不能复用为独立阳性。

shortlist_review.subject: LoongArch: Clean up the architectural interrupt definitions
shortlist_review.reason: 标题为中断定义整理，没有 SMP online 首次消费线索。
